edits.find:
Anovulatory cycles from an immature hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian axis are genuinely normal in the first 1–2 years after menarche — which is why most people choose reassurance. But reassurance requires two things: a benign cause and an acceptable consequence. Anemia is a consequence. The physiology being normal doesn't make the outcome acceptable.

Mechanism: immature axis → no LH surge → anovulation → no corpus luteum → no progesterone → unopposed estrogen drives continuous proliferation with no secretory differentiation → the lining outgrows its blood supply and sheds unpredictably. Progesterone converts proliferative to secretory endometrium and produces organized withdrawal bleeding.

Mechanism: the immature axis produces no LH (luteinizing hormone) surge, so anovulation follows. Without a corpus luteum there is no progesterone. Unopposed estrogen drives continuous proliferation with no secretory differentiation. The lining outgrows its blood supply and sheds unpredictably. edits.find:
When two explanations produce identical symptoms, test for the one that changes management and can't be missed. DMPA side effects — breast soreness, weight gain, fatigue, amenorrhea — are indistinguishable from early pregnancy. And the arithmetic assassin: DMPA is due every 13 weeks; her last injection was 4 months ago, so she has been uncovered.

The structural rule: a pregnancy test precedes every contraception decision, every amenorrhea workup, and absolutely every IUD placement — inserting an IUD into an established intrauterine pregnancy can disrupt it.

edits.find: Two findings do the work, and they are the two that alcohol does not cause. Cleft palate and distal phalangeal hypoplasia together are fetal hydantoin syndrome — in utero exposure to a folate-antagonising antiepileptic, classically phenytoin, which crosses the placenta and produces low fetal folate with high oxidative metabolites. The wide anterior fontanelle and microcephaly complete it. Fetal alcohol syndrome shares the microcephaly and the midface hypoplasia but has no association with clefting, and its signature is a smooth philtrum with a thin vermilion border and short palpebral fissures — none of which is described.

edits.find: Primary amenorrhea is no menarche by 15 with secondary sexual characteristics, or by 13 without them. The first step is pelvic ultrasonography, and the reason is architectural: the obstruction can sit anywhere along hypothalamus → pituitary → ovary → uterus → vagina, and imaging is the only test that answers the anatomical half of that chain in one move. Every hormonal test is interpretable only once you know whether there is a uterus. Then the algorithm forks twice. Uterus present → read the FSH: high FSH with high LH is primary ovarian insufficiency, and with short stature that is Turner syndrome — gonadal dysgenesis from loss of an X, giving streak ovaries and absent oestrogen, while intact adrenals still produce pubic hair. Uterus absent → read the pubic hair: present means the androgen receptor works, so 46,XX Müllerian agenesis; absent means it does not, so 46,XY complete androgen insensitivity.
edits.with: Primary amenorrhea is no menarche by 15 with secondary sexual characteristics, or by 13 without them. The first step is pelvic ultrasonography. The obstruction can sit anywhere from the hypothalamus and pituitary to the ovary, uterus and vagina. Imaging is the only test that answers the anatomical half of that chain in one move. Every hormonal test is interpretable only once you know whether there is a uterus. Uterus present → read the FSH (follicle-stimulating hormone). High FSH with high LH (luteinizing hormone) is primary ovarian insufficiency. With short stature, that is Turner syndrome: gonadal dysgenesis from loss of an X. Turner syndrome gives streak ovaries and absent oestrogen, while intact adrenals still produce pubic hair. Uterus absent → read the pubic hair. Pubic hair present means the androgen receptor works, so the diagnosis is 46,XX Müllerian agenesis. Absent pubic hair means it does not, so the diagnosis is 46,XY complete androgen insensitivity.
